sql:
SELECT 
    s.Phone
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE 
    s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath > 3000 AND s.NumGE1500 > 0
ORDER BY 
    s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.Phone
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE 
    s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrRead > 3000 AND s.NumGE1500 > 0
ORDER BY 
    s.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    T2.Phone
FROM 
    satscores AS T1
JOIN 
    schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE 
    T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrRead >= 1500
GROUP BY 
    T2.School, T2.Phone
ORDER BY 
    COUNT(T1.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.Phone 
FROM schools AS T1 
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T2.NumGE1500 > 0 
ORDER BY T2.NumGE1500 DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrWrite > 3 * 1500
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Phone 
FROM satscores AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.NumGE1500 > 0 
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.AvgScrWrite > 1500
ORDER BY ss.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrRead > 3000 AND ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrRead - ss.AvgScrWrite > 1500
ORDER BY ss.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 1500
GROUP BY T2.School
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 1500
GROUP BY T2.School
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 1500
GROUP BY T2.School
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 1500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(s.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 1500
GROUP BY f.School Name
ORDER BY COUNT(s.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumTstTakr > 1500
    GROUP BY cds
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds;

SELECT T2.Phone 
FROM satscores AS T1 
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.NumGE1500 > 0 
GROUP BY T2.School 
ORDER BY SUM(T1.NumGE1500) DESC 
LIMIT 1;
